@prefix nltl: <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#> .
@prefix qudt: <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/> .
@prefix sh: <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#> .
@prefix unit: <http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/> .
@prefix xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .

nltl:ShipBottomLowerRegionBoundaryShape
    a sh:NodeShape ;
    sh:targetClass nltl:ship ;
    sh:property [
        sh:path nltl:hasBottomRegionLowerRegionBoundaryPoint ;
        sh:minCount 1 ;
        sh:node [
            a sh:NodeShape ;
            sh:class nltl:hullBoundaryPoint ;
            sh:property [
                sh:path nltl:shellInclinationAngle ;
                sh:minCount 1 ;
                sh:node [
                    a sh:NodeShape ;
                    sh:class qudt:QuantityValue ;
                    sh:property [
                        sh:path qudt:numericValue ;
                        sh:minCount 1 ;
                        sh:datatype xsd:decimal ;
                        sh:hasValue "7"^^xsd:decimal
                    ] ;
                    sh:property [
                        sh:path qudt:unit ;
                        sh:minCount 1 ;
                        sh:hasValue unit:DEG
                    ] ;
                    sh:sparql [
                        sh:message "The shell inclination angle quantity must have numericValue exactly 7 and unit http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/DEG." ;
                        sh:select """
                            PREFIX qudt: <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/>
                            PREFIX unit: <http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/>
                            PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
                            SELECT $this
                            WHERE {
                                {
                                    $this qudt:numericValue ?value .
                                    FILTER (?value != "7"^^xsd:decimal)
                                }
                                UNION
                                {
                                    $this qudt:unit ?unitValue .
                                    FILTER (?unitValue != unit:DEG)
                                }
                            }
                        """
                    ]
                ]
            ]
        ]
    ] .
<END_SHACL>
